title: Listening Drill — Harbour history cruise
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Harbour history cruise
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the old harbour. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the ferry terminal. The visit itself will last ninety minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a jacket.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the west pier. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: the upper deck may be windy. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
